name: Msiexec.exe
description: Used by Windows to execute msi files
summary: Launch local or network accessible MSI files

associated_campaigns.name: RedDelta Modified PlugX Infection Chain Operations

attack_relationships.description: APT38 has used `msiexec.exe` to execute malicious files.
Machete has used msiexec to install the Machete malware.
Molerats has used msiexec.exe to execute an MSI payload.
Rancor has used msiexec to download and execute malicious installer files over HTTP.
TA505 has used msiexec to download and execute malicious Windows Installer files.
ZIRCONIUM has used the msiexec.exe command-line utility to download and execute malicious MSI files.

During the 3CX Supply Chain Attack, AppleJeus delivered components using a Windows Installer package (.msi). The MSI installer extracted several files and executed the 3CXDesktopApp.exe, which loaded the malicious library file ffmpeg.dll.

attack_relationships.source: RedDelta Modified PlugX Infection Chain Operations
attack_relationships.description: Mustang Panda initial payloads downloaded a Windows Installer MSI file that in turn dropped follow-on files leading to installation of PlugX during RedDelta Modified PlugX Infection Chain Operations.
AppleJeus has been installed via MSI installer.
Chaes has used.MSI files as an initial way to start the infection chain.
Clop can use msiexec.exe to disable security tools on the system.
DEADEYE can use `msiexec.exe` for execution of malicious DLL.

Duqu has used msiexec to execute malicious Windows Installer packages. Additionally, a PROPERTY=VALUE pair containing a 56-bit encryption key has been used to decrypt the main payload from the installer packages.
FlawedAmmyy has been installed via `msiexec.exe`.
Grandoreiro can use MSI files to execute DLLs.
IcedID can inject itself into a suspended msiexec.exe process to send beacons to C2 while appearing as a normal msi application. IcedID has also used msiexec.exe to deploy the IcedID loader.
Javali has used the MSI installer to download and execute malicious payloads.
Latrodectus has called `msiexec` to install remotely-hosted MSI files.
LoudMiner used an MSI installer to install the virtualization software.
Maze has delivered components for its ransomware attacks using MSI files, some of which have been executed from the command-line using msiexec.
Melcoz can use MSI files with embedded VBScript for execution.
Metamorfo has used MsiExec.exe to automatically execute files.
Mispadu has been installed via MSI installer.
QakBot can use MSIExec to spawn multiple cmd.exe processes.
Ragnar Locker has been delivered as an unsigned MSI package that was executed with msiexec.exe.

Raspberry Robin uses msiexec.exe for post-installation communication to command and control infrastructure. Msiexec.exe is executed referencing a remote resource for second-stage payload retrieval and execution.
Raspberry Robin retrieves its second stage payload in a variety of ways such as through msiexec.exe abuse, or running the curl command to download the payload to the victim's %AppData% folder.
RedLine Stealer has been installed via MSI Installer.
Tsundere Botnet has been distributed via an MSI installer.
RemoteUtilities can use Msiexec to install a service.

Exploitation of CVE-2017-11882 leads to download and installation of the malicious MSI package zus.msi through Windows Installer, which delivers LokiBot.

The VBS file written by the macro downloads a second-stage MSI payload from the attacker server and executes it with msiexec.

The final command of the document macro downloads and installs the .MSI file, a downloader that retrieves and runs the FlawedAmmyy RAT.

associated_commands.intent: PsExec was used to run msiexec so that TightVNC was downloaded and installed from a remote location.
The downloaded PIF file only invokes msiexec to download and execute an MSI installer hosted on an attacker-registered web address.
The deobfuscated shortcut command downloads and installs an MSI payload from a remote server.
The macro in the phishing document runs this command; /q makes msiexec run in the background while it downloads and loads an MSI binary.
A second malicious document runs similar msiexec command line artifacts that download an MSI installer from office365onlinehome.com.

attack_detection_strategies.name: Detection of Msiexec Abuse for Local, Network, and DLL Execution

analytics.description: Detection of msiexec.exe execution where command-line arguments reference remote MSI packages, UNC paths, HTTP/HTTPS URLs, or DLLs, correlated with subsequent module loads and/or network connections to previously unseen destinations. The behavioral chain links process creation of msiexec.exe with suspicious parameters, network activity to retrieve payloads, and module loading indicative of malicious installation or DLL execution.
